verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature, such as a full-workspace export to CSV or JSON. What it does show is a REST API with list endpoints and a vague pricing line about accessing workspace data. A developer could build an export from these, but that is a building block, not the capability itself. The Jira, Trello and CSV mentions describe importing into Shortcut, not exporting out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
